breaking_news.headline: Alan Greenspan, the legendary former Federal Reserve chair, dies
breaking_news.summary: During his chairmanship, Greenspan was celebrated as possibly the best central banker in history. But later, his reputation was tarnished by the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.

breaking_news.headline: Did you know? Alan Greenspan and Ayn Rand were close friends
breaking_news.summary: One of the most intellectually important relationships in the life of the late Fed chair Alan Greenspan was with his close friend, the formidable novelist and libertarian thinker Ayn Rand.

breaking_news.headline: When falling housing prices are good news — and when they're not
breaking_news.summary: Denver renters are celebrating falling housing costs. But sometimes cheaper housing is a sign of economic decline. How can you tell the difference?

breaking_news.headline: Is AI 'one big bubble'? Behind the tech sell-off
breaking_news.summary: Investors are selling off AI-related stocks as doubts are starting to surface over whether the massive spending on AI is worth the investment and whether it's "one big bubble."

breaking_news.headline: Congress passes the largest housing affordability bill in decades — and Trump cancels the signing
breaking_news.summary: President Trump canceled a signing ceremony for the bill Wednesday, saying Congress must first pass a strict voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Meta plans to release AI-powered prediction market app, documents show
breaking_news.summary: The company is building an app separate from Facebook and Instagram where people can wager on the outcome of real-world events, using "play money."

breaking_news.headline: World Cup fans are missing games after their resale tickets fall through
breaking_news.summary: The ordeal has left fans forced to either miss out on a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity or scramble to find new tickets, often costing more and for worse seats.

breaking_news.headline: This mindset shift can help you get better at using up your leftovers
breaking_news.summary: Don't let your leftovers go to waste. Cookbook authors share clever storage techniques — like an "Eat Me First" box in your fridge — and cooking tricks to help you make the most of your food scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Three firefighters die battling huge wildfires on Colorado-Utah border
breaking_news.summary: A number of blazes have been raging across Utah and Colorado, leading both governors to declare states of emergency.

breaking_news.headline: Fourteen killed in Saudi Arabia helicopter crash
breaking_news.summary: The aircraft belonged to state oil giant Aramco and the cause of the crash is being investigated.

breaking_news.headline: Australian man charged with murder after girl found dead in suitcase in Thailand
breaking_news.summary: The 17-year-old's body was found discarded near a railway track on Saturday, police say.

breaking_news.headline: US and Iran exchange strikes and accuse each other of violating ceasefire
breaking_news.summary: Iran says it has launched retaliatory attacks at US infrastructure in Kuwait and Bahrain after the US said it hit multiple targets across Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Eleven killed after plane carrying skydivers crashes in eastern France
breaking_news.summary: The pilot and 10 passengers died in the incident, local officials said.

breaking_news.headline: Europe's heatwave linked to 1,300 deaths, WHO says, as Germany hits record 41.7C
breaking_news.summary: WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that Europe is not prepared for high temperatures.

breaking_news.headline: In Caracas, this feels like the hardest moment in Venezuela's modern history
breaking_news.summary: Rescue teams are working ceaselessly to reach those trapped under rubble. But as hope fades, anger is growing.

breaking_news.headline: Two boys rescued from Venezuela earthquake rubble after days of being trapped
breaking_news.summary: Rescuers spent six hours carefully digging to reach one of the boys, as many residents continue searching through the rubble by hand, still waiting for heavy machinery to arrive.

breaking_news.headline: What's happening to petrol prices now oil is back to pre-Iran war levels?
breaking_news.summary: When the conflict began on 28 February, fuel costs jumped as the war disrupted the production and transportation of energy across the Middle East.

breaking_news.headline: Asia stock markets slide as tech shares slump
breaking_news.summary: Trading on South Korea's Kospi index was halted for the third time this week to prevent panic selling.

breaking_news.headline: Power banks and vapes now biggest fire risk on planes
breaking_news.summary: Lithium battery fires are the number one safety risk to aircraft, yet the number of devices found in hold bags has nearly doubled in a year.

breaking_news.headline: I'm back at home again after uni - here's how I'm making it work
breaking_news.summary: Rising costs are forcing more young adults to live with their parents, here's how not to come to blows.
